meta.title: Partner With Us
meta.description: Partner with EZ Recruitment: structured international recruitment cooperation for recruitment agencies and staffing companies, with clear responsibilities and direct communication.

hero.title: Build Stronger Recruitment Partnerships
hero.intro: EZ Recruitment cooperates with recruitment agencies and staffing companies on international workforce projects, with clear responsibilities, direct communication and a long-term view.

why.heading: Why Explore a Partnership with EZ Recruitment?
why.intro: International recruitment works when every party knows its role. This is how we approach cooperation.

items.title: Clear roles
items.text: Responsibilities between EZ Recruitment, partners, employers and candidates are agreed before work begins.

items.title: Direct communication
items.text: You deal with the people managing the cooperation, with no unnecessary layers between you and the work.

items.title: A structured process
items.text: Defined stages run from the employer's requirement to deployment and follow-up, so every project is easy to track.

items.title: Commitments employers value
items.text: A two-month replacement guarantee, an English-speaking representative in each worker group and ongoing worker follow-up support trust on the employer side of every project.

items.title: A long-term outlook
items.text: We prefer lasting working relationships over one-off transactions, and we plan cooperation accordingly.

who.heading: Who Can Partner With Us?
who.note: This page is for recruitment businesses. EZ Recruitment does not provide placement services to individual job seekers.

areas.heading: Potential Areas of Cooperation
areas.intro: The scope is agreed case by case. These are the areas we most often discuss.

items.title: International recruitment cooperation
items.text: Working together on projects where employer demand and candidate sourcing sit in different countries.

items.title: Recruitment coordination
items.text: Coordinating the steps between employers, partners and candidates so that nothing is left unclear.

items.title: Candidate identification and screening
items.text: Agreeing criteria with the employer and assessing candidates against them consistently.

items.title: Cross-border recruitment cooperation
items.text: Aligning timelines, documents and communication across different markets.

items.title: Workforce planning support
items.text: Helping define requirements, numbers and timelines before sourcing begins.

items.title: Long-term partnerships
items.text: Building repeat cooperation for employers with continuing workforce needs.

steps.title: Inquiry
steps.text: You tell us about your business and the cooperation you have in mind.

steps.title: Initial discussion
steps.text: We talk through your markets, your strengths and the employer requirements you work with.

steps.title: Scope definition
steps.text: We agree what each side will do, in which markets and for which sectors.

steps.title: Written agreement
steps.text: Responsibilities, communication and commercial terms are set out in writing.

steps.title: Cooperation and follow-up
steps.text: We run projects together and review how the cooperation is working.

responsibilities.heading: Responsibilities and Communication
responsibilities.intro: A typical division of responsibilities. The final split is agreed for each cooperation.

rows.does: Workforce planning and requirement briefs, coordination of the process, communication with employers and workers, and follow-up after deployment.
Sourcing and presenting candidates against agreed criteria, keeping candidate information accurate and responding within agreed timelines.
Defining requirements, making hiring decisions and providing workplace information and instructions.
Providing accurate information and taking part in assessment and preparation.
Carrying out the local procedures in their country as part of the agreed cooperation structure.

items.question: What happens after I submit the form?
items.answer: We review your inquiry and contact you at your business email to arrange an initial discussion.

items.question: Who can partner with EZ Recruitment?
items.answer: Recruitment agencies, staffing and labour supply companies, international recruitment consultants and similar businesses. We do not work with individual job seekers.

items.question: Do you guarantee a number of candidates or a fixed volume?
items.answer: No. Cooperation is agreed case by case, and volumes depend on employer demand and the scope agreed in writing.

items.question: How are commercial terms agreed?
items.answer: After the initial discussion we set out responsibilities, communication and commercial terms in a written agreement before projects begin.

items.question: Can we cooperate if our business is outside Europe?
items.answer: Yes. Our work is international. Tell us your country and the markets you work in, and we will discuss how cooperation could work.

items.question: Is the two-month replacement guarantee part of partnership projects?
items.answer: The guarantee applies in accordance with the agreed guarantee terms for each project. We confirm how it applies during the scope discussion.

form.heading: Partnership Inquiry Form
form.intro: Tell us about your business and the cooperation you are interested in. Fields marked * are required.
form.notice: This form is for recruitment agencies and businesses. We are unable to assist individual job seekers through this website.
form.successHeading: Thank you for your partnership inquiry
form.successText: Your inquiry has been sent. We will review it and contact you at the business email you provided. An inquiry does not by itself create an agreement.
form.errorText: Something went wrong while sending your inquiry. Please try again, or email us directly.

cta.heading: Let's talk about how we could work together
cta.text: If you run a recruitment business and are exploring international cooperation, we would be glad to hear from you.
